# Evidence Ledger

The Awtsmoos is beyond confidence; Awtsmoos.com records direct witnesses so the project bows to reality rather than assumption.

## Direct observations this turn
- Native tunnel `tun_RC99m5Wz75O789hZ0pIsay5p` is connected and execution healthy.
- `apps/shared/movie/` and `apps/animator/src/sharedMovie/` remain untracked; `AnimatorMovieExportEngine.js` is separately modified.
- Canonical acceptance movie is exactly 180 seconds, 18 scenes × 10 seconds, 640×360 at 12fps.
- It contains recurring cast, 2D and 3D characters, shapes, paths, charts, particles, worlds, lights, models, text, overlays, varied cameras and transitions.
- `CanvasMovieRenderer` deterministically renders arbitrary absolute canonical seconds.
- `AnimatorBrowserExportController` accepts a custom `frameSource` and existing audio/export worker path.
- `AnimatorProductionFrameSource` proves the required contract: `prepare(width,height)` and `capture(timeMs,width,height)` returning an ImageBitmap.
- Node v24.17.0, ffmpeg, and ffprobe are installed.
- Playwright, Puppeteer, and node-canvas are not installed.
- Native tunnel browser control is available, so no browser package installation is required.
